{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] sum
);
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] x;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] add_p, sub_p;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] add_g, ab_g, ba_g;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] add_c, ab_borrow, ba_borrow;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] add_result, ab_result, ba_result;

    assign x = a ^ b;
    assign add_p = a | b;
    assign sub_p = ~x;
    assign add_g = a & b;
    assign ab_g = (~a) & b;
    assign ba_g = a & (~b);

    pw_alu_group_carry #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) u_add (
        .p(add_p), .g(add_g), .c(add_c)
    );
    pw_alu_group_carry #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) u_ab (
        .p(sub_p), .g(ab_g), .c(ab_borrow)
    );
    pw_alu_group_carry #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) u_ba (
        .p(sub_p), .g(ba_g), .c(ba_borrow)
    );

    assign add_result = x ^ add_c;
    assign ab_result = x ^ ab_borrow;
    assign ba_result = x ^ ba_borrow;

    always @* begin
        case (Oper)
            3'b000: sum = add_result;
            3'b001: sum = ab_result;
            3'b010: sum = ba_result;
            3'b011: sum = a | b;
            3'b100: sum = a & b;
            3'b101: sum = x;
            3'b110: sum = ~x;
            default: sum = {WIDTH{1'b0}};
        endcase
    end
endmodule

module pw_alu_group_carry #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] p,
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] g,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] c
);
    localparam GROUPS = (WIDTH + 3) / 4;
    localparam PAD_WIDTH = GROUPS * 4;
    localparam LEVELS = $clog2(GROUPS);

    wire [PAD_WIDTH-1:0] pp, gg;
    wire [GROUPS-1:0] tree_p [0:LEVELS];
    wire [GROUPS-1:0] tree_g [0:LEVELS];
    wire [GROUPS-1:0] group_c;

    genvar i, j, s;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < PAD_WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin: pad
            if (i < WIDTH) begin: real_bit
                assign pp[i] = p[i];
                assign gg[i] = g[i];
            end else begin: unused_bit
                assign pp[i] = 1'b1;
                assign gg[i] = 1'b0;
            end
        end

        for (j = 0; j < GROUPS; j = j + 1) begin: groups
            assign tree_p[0][j] = &pp[4*j +: 4];
            assign tree_g[0][j] = gg[4*j+3]
                | (pp[4*j+3] & gg[4*j+2])
                | (pp[4*j+3] & pp[4*j+2] & gg[4*j+1])
                | (pp[4*j+3] & pp[4*j+2] & pp[4*j+1] & gg[4*j]);
            if (j == 0) begin: first_group
                assign group_c[j] = 1'b0;
            end else begin: later_group
                assign group_c[j] = tree_g[LEVELS][j-1];
            end
        end

        for (s = 0; s < LEVELS; s = s + 1) begin: prefix_level
            for (j = 0; j < GROUPS; j = j + 1) begin: prefix_node
                if (j >= (1 << s)) begin: combine
                    assign tree_p[s+1][j] = tree_p[s][j]
                        & tree_p[s][j-(1 << s)];
                    assign tree_g[s+1][j] = tree_g[s][j]
                        | (tree_p[s][j] & tree_g[s][j-(1 << s)]);
                end else begin: pass_node
                    assign tree_p[s+1][j] = tree_p[s][j];
                    assign tree_g[s+1][j] = tree_g[s][j];
                end
            end
        end

        for (i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin: bit_carry
            if ((i % 4) == 0) begin: offset_zero
                assign c[i] = group_c[i/4];
            end else if ((i % 4) == 1) begin: offset_one
                assign c[i] = gg[i-1]
                    | (pp[i-1] & group_c[i/4]);
            end else if ((i % 4) == 2) begin: offset_two
                assign c[i] = gg[i-1]
                    | (pp[i-1] & gg[i-2])
                    | (pp[i-1] & pp[i-2] & group_c[i/4]);
            end else begin: offset_three
                assign c[i] = gg[i-1]
                    | (pp[i-1] & gg[i-2])
                    | (pp[i-1] & pp[i-2] & gg[i-3])
                    | (pp[i-1] & pp[i-2] & pp[i-3] & group_c[i/4]);
            end
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The reported worst paths cross substantial arithmetic carry logic before reaching the final operation selection. The mapped names do not identify a particular source operation, but the long input-to-high-result-bit dependency is consistent with carry/borrow propagation.",
  "rewrite": "Compute addition and both subtraction directions in parallel using explicit four-bit carry/borrow groups and a logarithmic group-prefix network. At WIDTH=64, sixteen groups require four prefix levels. Expanded local equations recover each bit's carry without a four-bit serial ripple. Both subtraction directions share equality propagation and the input XOR; addition uses OR propagation. The original operation-selection case is retained.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The intended improvement is a shorter, explicitly bounded carry/borrow path relative to the measured 3.00 ns baseline. A numerical timing gain is not established: this candidate has not been run through the specified mapping, STA, or electrical checks.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Parallel prefix networks trade additional group-combine logic and routing for reduced carry depth. Four-bit grouping limits prefix-node count, and the subtraction propagate network is shared. Actual mapped area and compliance with the 13121.834880 um2 cap require evaluation; neither is claimed as measured.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For every binary input, addition and subtraction are modulo 2^WIDTH. Subtraction uses borrow generation (~a)&b or a&(~b), equality propagation ~(a^b), and result (a^b) XOR borrow-in. All seven operations and the 111 zero default remain unchanged. The unsigned ports, WIDTH parameter, module name, and combinational interface are preserved. Partial final groups and positive widths smaller than four are supported. No state, latency, latches, assumptions, or undefined outputs are introduced; there are no CRC ports in this module."
}
